title: Release pipeline: bound release.yml jobs, bootstrap via scripts, make workflow_dispatch a non-publishing dry run
goal: release.yml (tag -> binaries) took 31.7 min for v0.21.12 (macOS 31.2, CUDA 23, linux-x86_64 16.6, aarch64 14.8). It has no job timeouts (a hung macOS build holds a release for 6 h), repeats the apt-get/mold boilerplate that test.yml already replaced with scripts/ci-system-deps.sh and scripts/ci-install-mold.sh, and workflow_dispatch on any ref runs the publishing steps, so a manual dispatch from a branch would create a GitHub release named after the branch. Make dispatch build-only so the pipeline can be validated without publishing, pin the invariants in tests/ci_workflow_perf.rs.
